title: Master Munda Source Census
description: Federated discovery census. Existing canonical source records remain in the master source register; corpus-specific records remain in their evidence-preserving source bundles; standalone bibliographic discoveries are recorded separately. Reader-facing web-discovery leads are maintained as a separate discovery layer and are not added to the audited source-identity total until deterministic deduplication/canonicalization is complete.

source_registers.counting_rule: Count volume slots with a verified external locator that are not already represented in the canonical master source register.

source_registers.id_policy: new standalone discoveries receive immutable SRC-MMSC identifiers after duplicate checking

source_registers.counting_rule: Discovery leads are searchable but excluded from the audited source-identity total until canonical deduplication confirms whether a lead is a new source, alternate locator, catalogue wrapper, or duplicate. WEB-MUN-0025, WEB-MUN-0030, WEB-MUN-0043, WEB-MUN-0045, WEB-MUN-0047, WEB-MUN-0057, WEB-MUN-0059, WEB-MUN-0063, WEB-MUN-0078, WEB-MUN-0079, WEB-MUN-0083, WEB-MUN-0084 and WEB-MUN-0087 have been canonicalized as standalone SRC-MMSC identities and are counted once through the standalone register, never double-counted here.

metrics.note: Audited source-identity count is repository-derived: 14 preserved canonical master-source records + 12 verified external Mundarica volume locators (II-XIII) + 15 standalone MMSC identities = 41. Eighty-seven reader-facing web-discovery leads are tracked separately; thirteen have been deterministically canonicalized and are counted once through the standalone source register. Seventy-four web-discovery leads remain outside the audited identity total. The primary MMSC search log remains normalized append-only through MMSC-SEARCH-000028; later run-specific records remain preserved pending safe consolidation. These metrics are not a claim that all Munda/Mundari sources have been discovered. Public, catalogue, index, dataset or media availability is never interpreted as unrestricted reuse permission.
